name: B10-0424/2026 – § 21 – Am 109
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 21. Takes note of the Commission’s adoption of the EU’s first anti-racism strategy 2026-2030 on 20 January 2026, and commends its commitment to addressing structural racism; is nevertheless concerned that the strategy does not mainstream anti-racism across other policy areas such as the Migration and Asylum Pact and the Return Regulation, which overlooks the violence that racialised people face every day in Europe, including discriminatory and deadly policing, the criminalisation of migrants and the violent repression of civic space for racialised and migrant-led organisations across Europe, including the increasing scrutiny of anti-racist non-governmental organisations;
